_readme: Past tests and next tests per client, loaded by `pnpm seed:history` (safe to re-run: tests are matched by title). Past tests go into a closed 'Sprint 0: history before the app', because exact dates weren't recorded. Planned tests go into the current sprint. Camber entries are MOCK data (titles start with 'Mock:'). Replace them with real findings from Esa.

clients.history_takeaway: History before the app: retargeting and competitive takeout are our most reliable lead sources. Cold free-trial pushes and industry-specific search don't work. Brand search scales only up to ~$1,500/day.

past.title: Hard push on free trials to a cold audience on all platforms
past.success_text: Activated free trials from cold audiences
past.findings_blockers: Bad quality traffic and a low number of activated free trials.

past.title: Increase budget on the Google Search brand campaign
past.success_text: More conversions without raising cost per conversion
past.findings_worked: A good increase in total conversions and a lower cost per conversion.
past.findings_blockers: There's a ceiling: above ~$1,500/day on the brand campaign, conversions stay flat and cost per conversion rises.

past.title: Dedicated industry free trials on paid search
past.success_text: Industry-specific searches converting to free trials
past.findings_blockers: People don't search by industry (e.g. "dns filtering for education sector"). They search generic keywords and look for a solution.

past.title: Promote the AI Security report on LinkedIn and Reddit
past.success_text: Affordable report leads that go on to start a trial
past.findings_blockers: Cost per lead form submission is very high, and people don't start a trial after downloading the report.
past.findings_notes: Next: consider making the report free (ungated) and remarketing to people who downloaded it.

past.title: Bing Ads push for MSP
past.findings_blockers: Several MSP-specific campaigns on Bing didn't reach the lead numbers we wanted.

past.title: Competitive takeout campaigns
past.success_text: High-quality leads that turn into deals
past.findings_worked: They perform well: on the more expensive side, but they generate high-quality leads with deals attached.
past.findings_blockers: Higher cost per lead than other campaigns.

past.title: Retargeting on all platforms
past.success_text: Good lead volume at a low cost per lead
past.findings_worked: A really positive response: a good number of leads at a low cost per lead.

planned.title: CTA on creatives: "Free Trial" vs "Book a demo" and "Contact us"
planned.hypothesis: Demo and contact CTAs attract higher-intent leads than free trials, which bring low-quality traffic.
planned.success_text: Lead quality at least as good as competitive takeout

planned.title: LinkedIn conversation ads with the AI Security report and Book a demo / Free Trial CTAs
planned.hypothesis: A conversational format gets report interest to the next step (demo or trial), which the gated download didn't.
planned.success_text: Report engagers booking demos or starting trials

planned.title: Bing Performance Max, with a landing page that only accepts business emails
planned.hypothesis: Filtering out personal emails at the form keeps Bing's reach while fixing lead quality.
planned.success_text: Business-email leads at or below $300 each

clients.history_takeaway: MOCK (replace with Esa): SMB converts best on high-intent Google terms and Meta instant forms. ABX on LinkedIn builds engagement with named accounts but needs longer than a sprint to show pipeline.

past.title: Mock: SMB Revenue Diagnostics Calculator as the LinkedIn lead magnet
past.success_text: SMB clinic leads at or below $200
past.findings_worked: MOCK: the calculator out-converted the guide download for SMB clinic owners. The interactive offer suits the audience.
past.findings_blockers: MOCK: leads needed a follow-up call to qualify.

past.title: Mock: SMB lead gen: Meta instant forms vs landing page
past.findings_worked: MOCK: instant forms roughly halved cost per lead.
past.findings_blockers: MOCK: lead quality from instant forms was mixed. Too few leads reached sales to judge quality within the sprint.

past.title: Mock: SMB Google: ABA billing high-intent terms vs broad RCM terms
past.success_text: Lower cost per result on high-intent terms
past.findings_worked: MOCK: ABA-billing-specific terms converted at a much lower cost than broad revenue-cycle terms.
past.findings_blockers: MOCK: search volume on the specific terms is limited, so budget can't scale far.

past.title: Mock: ABX: personalised ads to named enterprise accounts ("Hi Rasmus" style)
past.findings_worked: MOCK: personalised ads roughly doubled CTR among target accounts versus generic enterprise ads.

past.title: Mock: ABX: thought leadership document ads to the Enterprise contact target list
past.success_text: Target accounts engaging and moving to meetings
past.findings_worked: MOCK: good document opens from target accounts.
past.findings_blockers: MOCK: no meetings within the sprint. The enterprise cycle is longer than two weeks, so this needs pipeline tracking in HubSpot.

past.title: Mock: SMB retargeting of website visitors on Meta
past.findings_blockers: MOCK: the retargeting audience was too small to spend the budget, and frequency climbed fast.

planned.title: Mock: SMB Google competitor terms campaign
planned.hypothesis: MOCK: clinics comparing billing providers are close to switching.
planned.success_text: Comparison-page leads at or below target

planned.title: Mock: SMB Meta video testimonial vs single image
planned.hypothesis: MOCK: a clinic owner testimonial builds trust faster than a static benefit image.

planned.title: Mock: ABX LinkedIn conversation ads offering the enterprise case study
planned.hypothesis: MOCK: a direct conversation with a case study offer turns engaged target accounts into meetings.
planned.success_text: At least 3 meetings booked from target accounts
